title: Add comprehensive README to docs folder with OctoAcme process overview
body:
## Summary
This PR adds a comprehensive README to the `docs/` folder that provides an overview of OctoAcme's project management processes and serves as a central navigation hub for all process documentation.

## What's included
- **Process Overview**: A 3-4 paragraph summary covering:
  - The five-phase project lifecycle (Initiation, Planning, Execution, Release, Retrospective)
  - Core personas and their roles (Product Managers, Project Managers, Developers)
  - Communication cadence and strategies
  - Quality assurance and delivery practices

- **Documentation Index**: Links to all process guide documents with brief descriptions
- **Usage Guide**: Clear instructions for different audiences (new team members, project leads, delivery teams)
- **Contribution Guidelines**: Reference to the issue template for proposing updates

## Related to
Closes #2

## Files Changed
- `docs/README.md` (new file)
